story.title: DeeSy short stories 3 : Connecting the Dots...
paragraphs_en: When we boarded the plane, my son took out his puzzle book and said to me, “Papa, let’s play ‘connecting the dots’.” “No beta”, I tried to explain, “You know Papa builds biiiiiig buildings....for that he has to work on his laptop even during vacation. But I have a surprise for you. Today, I’ll show you the tallest building I have built – my award winning project.” As the plane took off I exclaimed, ““Look son, that one is the city tower and just next to it is my dream project. I know we have boarded an early flight and so it is pretty dark outside but if you see carefully, you can locate it.”

Disappointed, he said, “Oh that small dot....because of THAT you missed my school project exhibition. ...I won first prize Papa....I wanted you to be there...”. Shocked by this reaction, I kept staring at him, simultaneously trying hard to remember what the school project was. When I looked back out of the window, the dot...er...the building had vanished as the plane had soared high. Aghast, I kept looking out and thinking.

I realized that for past many months, I had kept feeling that I was missing something but couldn’t pinpoint it. But now at 36000 feet above the ground, it dawned on me. I didn’t want to miss the ‘sun’rise. Suddenly, the sky seemed clear of any clouds. “Beta”, I called softly, ‘Let’s do the connecting dots puzzle.” His face lit up. Grinning, he asked, “but what about your dot I mean your work?” Holding his hand tightly I replied, “That can wait.....I have to connect some more important dots first....”
